identity.fantasy: A poison-to-medicine healer who builds Mycelial and Mist networks, extracts harmful effects, and enters Vizier Form for sustained recovery.
identity.one_line: A poison-to-medicine healer who builds Mycelial and Mist networks, extracts harmful effects, and enters Vizier Form for sustained recovery. The defining decision is contextual: Triage, dispels, mana, and form timing continually change priorities.

mechanics.core_loop: A poison-to-medicine healer using Mycelial Healing, Mending Mist, Good Venom, extraction, rituals, and Vizier Form. It specializes in healing-over-time networks and can convert harmful themes into recovery. It also has a battle resurrection, despite at least one recent third-party list omitting it.
mechanics.single_target: Build a healing-over-time network with Mycelial Healing, Mending Mist, and Good Venom, use critical heals and mana regeneration to sustain it, and reserve immediate tools for gaps. No source establishes a universal healing priority.
mechanics.aoe: Spread HoTs and rituals across the party, then use utility, dispels, and the battle resurrection as encounter needs demand. The captured build emphasizes intellect, spell power, spirit, crit heals, and mana regeneration.
mechanics.movement_and_target_switching: Hybrid range and persistent healing aid movement, although form safety is currently disputed.
mechanics.defense_and_control: Its structural defensive package includes Alkahest, Shadra's Vigil, Mycelial Healing, Mending Mist, Spiritual Healing.
mechanics.group_utility: Group or control tools include Alkahest, Mycelial Healing, Good Venom, Book of Shadra, Vizier Form.

failure_modes.text: Falling behind the HoT network, exhausting mana, or entering a poorly timed or reportedly bugged form can leave too little immediate recovery.
Allowing several HoTs to expire together forces reactive healing from a kit built to stay ahead.
Relying on the reported form behavior without reproducing it can lead to the wrong explanation for weak output.
